_about: Measured 24sep2026 with StataNow 19.5 (console, batch) on sysuse auto: `twoway <type> ... || <type> ... || <type> ...' (three plots; dot on in 1/10; `ciscatter' is lfitci || scatter || scatter, whose band is plot 1 and line plot 2) under each scheme below, a file in the working directory (for 'economist', Stata's own economist); each value is the plot's marker outline width in Stata linewidth units, read from .Graph.plotregion1.plot<k>.style.marker.linestyle.width.setting.  markerstyle-p#.style: `set linestyle scheme p#mark'; linestyle-p#mark.style: `set width scheme p#mark', so the chain is linewidth p#mark -> pmark -> p# -> p; mk3's `p1dotmark' reaches no twoway dot.  'mlwidth' is `scatter, mlwidth(vthin) || scatter' under mk1.  The SVG of scheme_visual/truth.json agrees: every drawn marker outline is as wide as that scheme's lines (s2color 8.64 SVG units, economist 19.01).

schemes.mk2:
#include s2color
linewidth pmark vvthick
linewidth p1mark thin
linewidth p3 vthick
schemes.mk3:
#include s2color
linewidth p1dotmark vvthick
linewidth p1mark thick
linewidth p2 vthick
